Islands & water

Attractions around Painan

Beyond Pantai Carocok, the Painan area has Bukit Langkisau and small bay islands. This page includes only objects with a real route link, not a long list.

Updated · 28 Oktober 2026

Nearest

In one day

Bukit Langkisau and Cingkuak Island are the two points with the clearest route link from Pantai Carocok. Both have dedicated pages.

  • Bukit Langkisau: hill panorama.
  • Cingkuak Island: bay crossing.
  • Central Painan: orientation and needs.

Farther

Needs confirmation

Objects outside the Painan bay may be interesting but differ in distance and access. Do not assume all fit a short visit.

Do not expand randomly

We do not include a long unverified list. Focus on points with a real route link from the beach.

Source

Verify yourself

For objects outside this list, consult an official map and ask Painan staff before planning a route.

Questions

Before you go

01What is near Pantai Carocok?+

The clearest are Bukit Langkisau and Cingkuak Island, both with a real route link from the beach.

02Are there waterfalls or lakes nearby?+

We do not include objects without a verified route link from the beach. Consult an official map for farther options.

03Can all be done in a day?+

Several points in the Painan area are enough, but farther objects need a separate trip.

04Where is the official source?+

Use an official map and ask Painan staff; this guide does not claim a complete list.
